cat > slug.py <<'E'
import re


def slugify(title: str) -> str:
    return re.sub(r'\s+', '-', title.lower())
E
cat >> tests/test_slug.py <<'E'


def test_slugify_single_space_is_one_hyphen():
    assert slugify('a b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_long_runs():
    assert slugify('a     b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_mixed_whitespace_runs():
    assert slugify('a \t\n b') == 'a-b'


def test_slugify_collapses_each_run_separately():
    assert slugify('a  b   c') == 'a-b-c'


def test_slugify_collapses_leading_and_trailing_runs():
    assert slugify('  a  ') == '-a-'


def test_slugify_lowercases_with_whitespace_runs():
    assert slugify('Hello   World') == 'hello-world'
E
/tmp/mt-venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests 2>&1 | tail -5
git add slug.py tests; git commit -qm "Collapse whitespace runs in slugify
